title: One Town Beat A 375-Year Eclipse Wait Twice
hook: One town waited just 7 years between total eclipses.
closing: Totality rewards location and timing, so every nearby chance matters.
question: Have you seen totality?

segments.say: One location normally waits 375 years for totality. Seeing it from home is extraordinarily rare.
Carbondale waited only 7 years between total eclipses. That town beat the typical wait by centuries.
The next contiguous US crossing comes after a 20-year gap. Eclipse access changes dramatically by generation.
